properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated April 10, [1937]; includes description of work and dinner with [Phil] Delany and [Max] Lessner; tennis with the Judge [James Ross], Max Polin and Bondie [William L. Bond]; dinner with [Phil] Delany and Dai [Enki]; meeting with Sun Fo; mentions [Ernest and Florence] Allison.
